description: Search free, curated public research by substring and optional topic. Preserve provenance, stale flags, rights and sample limitations. These are not verified jobs or buyer demand.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching results to return. Defaults to 10, with a range of 1 to 20.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match in the record title, summary, or request text. Omit to skip text filtering.

topic.description: Exact Help Map topic to filter by. Omit to include all topics.

name: search_help_map
